key_highlights: ASX slides on broad weakness across banks, tech, and mining; energy stocks provide partial support amid rising oil prices and Hormuz Strait escalation
Iron ore in severe downturn — BHP, RIO, FMG under pressure; 'iron ore is drowning' signals structural demand weakness from China
Property sector faces GFC-level stress: Bathla and home builders collapsing, RBA explicitly unlikely to intervene, NZ house crash reverberates
Gold sector resilient: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Kaiser restocks Tassie, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M, Larvotto strikes NSW multi-metal deposit
Santos under fire as gas cartel dynamics shift; energy sector rallies on oil/Hormuz risk premium
Geopolitical risk elevated: Hormuz Strait battle, far-right victory in Germany, Trump trade threats, Canada-US tensions
Private credit exposure in construction sector exposed via Bathla collapse; systemic risk to lenders
CPI data and short trading week ahead; hyperscaler bond issuance pushing global rates higher

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG; gold counter-cyclical strength with multiple ASX producers hitting milestones; multi-metal exploration active
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; gold and base-metal explorers (Aureka, Larvotto, Forrestania, Kaiser) offer relative value; BHP may face margin compression and strategic review

sectors.trend: Big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) falling on property credit risk and private credit exposure via construction collapses; RBA signals no property rescue
sectors.implications: Watch NPL migration in residential and construction lending; super policy pressure on Treasury (Joyce) may constrain fiscal support; private credit losses could hit ASX lenders

sectors.trend: Oil prices rising on Hormuz Strait escalation; Santos under regulatory/political pressure as gas cartel narrative emerges; energy stocks rally
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) faces reputational and regulatory risk; Woodside (WDS.AX) and oil-exposed names benefit from geopolitical premium; LNG pricing supportive

sectors.trend: GFC-level stress: Bathla collapse, building industry capacity crisis, NZ house crash, RBA non-intervention; Parramatta Metro $880M development a rare positive
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW, ICPS, DGL) face occupancy and valuation pressure; construction names (WTC, CGC) at risk; private credit in property a contagion channel

sectors.trend: Healthcare access crisis highlighted; consumer squeezed by mortgage costs driving second-job participation; living standards decline masked by public sector employment
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX defensive appeal rises; discretionary consumer under pressure; WES/WOW benefit from value-seeking

sectors.trend: ASX tech falls; global software sector showing early recovery signals but caution advised; Dell EPS growth and hyperscaler bond issuance impact rates
sectors.implications: ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) lags; global tech (Dell, Archer) offers selective opportunities; rate pressure from hyperscaler bonds a headwind

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP/RIO/FMG weight; rotate into gold and energy; monitor Chinese PMI and steel data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property sector contagion via private credit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Screen bank NPL pipelines; avoid construction-linked credit; favour cash-rich REITs
Maintain energy and gold hedges; monitor AUD/USD; keep cash buffer 10-15%

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy inaction on property / rate path uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid rate-sensitive property REITs; favour fixed-income and dividend payers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global rate pressure from hyperscaler bond issuance
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favour floating-rate and equity over long bonds
Monitor grain and soft commodity prices; agribusiness names (SUG, TNL) may see input cost pressure

opportunities.rationale: Gold at record highs on geopolitical risk and Trump uncertainty; Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser restocking, Aureka $8.9M acquisition, Larvotto NSW strike signal sector momentum

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical energy overweight on Hormuz risk premium
opportunities.rationale: Oil rising on Strait escalation; Santos gas cartel narrative creates volatility but WDS and oil-exposed names benefit from supply risk
Consumer squeeze from mortgage costs; healthcare access crisis supports CSL; WES/WOW benefit from value migration

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / large-cap mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP facing strategic review; China demand weakness persistent
GFC-level property stress, Bathla collapse, RBA non-intervention, private credit contagion risk
Geopolitical volatility, CPI data week, hyperscaler bond supply pressure on rates

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure (1-3 months): iron ore weakness, property credit concerns, and geopolitical risk cap upside. Energy and gold provide sector rotation support. CPI data and short trading week add volatility. RBA unlikely to cut aggressively given property risk. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and property credit losses are contained. Gold, energy, and healthcare offer structural tailwinds. Consumer recovery delayed by mortgage burden. Public sector employment masking private-sector weakness is a medium-term concern. Super policy changes may unlock household spending.
